detail_observations.text: Quest Offering You say, "Hail, Rache Weaver." "You've come a long way from Tursh," he says. "And I'm sure you've been away far longer than Investigator Trenkle thought you would be. You'll want to return to him there and report back what you've discovered." Objectives Report back to Investigator Trenkle in Tursh. Quest Rewards 25 copper Quest Completion Investigator Trenkle "You've been gone quite a while," Trenklke says. "Have you been sleeping on the job? Did you just walk outside of the town and wander around for a while?" "Now that is an interesting tale," he says, hearing your report. "I never assumed it would go that far, or that deep into New Targonor. I'm actually impressed with you. Thank you for the hard work." "However, it seems that even with everything you've done, there's still more work to be done. If you want it of course. I've heard some interesting tales coming out of the city if you'd like something else to look into." 25 Copper

pages.article_html:
Back The Beginning

Level 4 · Diplomacy · New Targonor · Thestra

Foreign Goods Market

Objectives

Report back to Investigator Trenkle in Tursh.

Description

"You've come a long way from Tursh," he says. "And I'm sure you've been away far longer than Investigator Trenkle thought you would be. You'll want to return to him there and report back what you've discovered."

What they say

On offering it

Jenia Remniol — the quest's giver; the write-up does not name a speaker
You've come a long way from Tursh, And I'm sure you've been away far longer than Investigator Trenkle thought you would be. You'll want to return to him there and report back what you've discovered.

Recorded by quest description (speaker inferred from the quest giver).

Notes

Quest Offering You say, "Hail, Rache Weaver." "You've come a long way from Tursh," he says. "And I'm sure you've been away far longer than Investigator Trenkle thought you would be. You'll want to return to him there and report back what you've discovered." Objectives Report back to Investigator Trenkle in Tursh. Quest Rewards 25 copper Quest Completion Investigator Trenkle "You've been gone quite a while," Trenklke says. "Have you been sleeping on the job? Did you just walk outside of the town and wander around for a while?" "Now that is an interesting tale," he says, hearing your report. "I never assumed it would go that far, or that deep into New Targonor. I'm actually impressed with you. Thank you for the hard work." "However, it seems that even with everything you've done, there's still more work to be done. If you want it of course. I've heard some interesting tales coming out of the city if you'd like something else to look into." 25 Copper

findings.observation: Heading displays Level 4, Diplomacy, New Targonor, Thestra and Foreign Goods Market. Details gives -36775, 26835, 36056. Objectives direct return to Investigator Trenkle in Tursh. These are distinct source contexts, not verified target spawns or coordinate units.

Details names Jenia Remniol as starter and Rache Weaver as also involved. Notes instead opens with Hail, Rache Weaver. Offering dialogue explicitly labels its Jenia attribution as inferred from quest giver and says the write-up does not name a speaker. Preserve this inference as source metadata, not a verified speaker identity.

Six disagreements are printed: loc from VGTacts DiploWiki and fandom, next quest from each, and starts npc from each. Full source labels and markup are retained in article evidence. Alternate field values are not displayed, so these conflicts cannot be resolved from this page.

Both primary and Notes objectives say report back to Investigator Trenkle in Tursh. Details hand-in and completion dialogue identify Investigator Trenkle, with Trenklke spelling inside dialogue retained verbatim in evidence. No exact spawn, conversation trigger or executable completion script is established.

Notes explicitly prints Quest Rewards 25 copper and later 25 Copper. Details separately prints Coin reward 25 without denomination. The Notes amount has explicit units; do not silently assign those units to every field or infer additional rewards.

Previous lists An Assassins Orders or Party Crasher or Revenge of the Rat. Next lists Back The Beginning itself alongside To The Mountains Base, Back To The Spring, Returning to the Source and Interwoven Threads; exact punctuation is retained in evidence. Self-reference and attributed next-quest disagreements remain unresolved; branch order and enforced prerequisites are unknown.

Repeatable yes is a labelled observation with unknown conditions. Source links the MMODB emulator archive mirror; original linked pages were not fetched. Mirrored provenance is not independent corroboration, and no new downloads occurred.
